title: Worksheet — Algebraic Expressions and Polynomials (Class 10 NIOS Mathematics)
instructions: Attempt all 10 questions in your notebook. Show every step of your working for the subjective questions; choose the single best option for MCQs. Answers without working will not receive full marks. Total time: 50 minutes.

questions.question: How many terms does the expression 5p^3 − 2p^2 + p − 9 have?
questions.explanation: Terms are separated by + or − signs. The expression has four parts: 5p^3, −2p^2, p and −9.

questions.question: The expression 3/x + 2 is a polynomial.
questions.explanation: A polynomial cannot have a variable in the denominator. 3/x = 3·x^(−1), a negative power, so the expression is not a polynomial.

questions.question: In the term −7x^2 y, the coefficient is ____.
questions.explanation: The coefficient is the numerical part of the term including its sign.

questions.question: What is the degree of the polynomial 4xy + 7x^2 y^3 − 2?
questions.explanation: Degree of each term is the sum of exponents of all variables. 4xy has degree 1+1=2; 7x^2 y^3 has degree 2+3=5; the constant has degree 0. The polynomial degree is the maximum, 5.

questions.question: Which of the following is the standard form of z^2 − 1 + 5z^4?
questions.explanation: Standard form lists terms in descending order of degree: degree 4, then degree 2, then the constant.

questions.question: Add (3x^2 − 5x + 2) and (x^2 + 7x − 6) using the horizontal method. Show every step.
questions.explanation: Group like terms: x^2 terms 3x^2 + x^2 = 4x^2; x terms −5x + 7x = 2x; constants 2 + (−6) = −4. Sum = 4x^2 + 2x − 4.

questions.question: Subtract (x^2 + 7x − 6) from (3x^2 − 5x + 2). Show all steps.
questions.explanation: Flip the sign of every term being subtracted, then add: 3x^2 − x^2 = 2x^2; −5x − 7x = −12x; 2 + 6 = 8. Result = 2x^2 − 12x + 8.

questions.question: Use FOIL to expand (x + 5)(x − 2) and write the result in standard form.
questions.explanation: First: x·x = x^2. Outer: x·(−2) = −2x. Inner: 5·x = 5x. Last: 5·(−2) = −10. Combine like terms: −2x + 5x = 3x. Result = x^2 + 3x − 10.

questions.question: Multiply (2x^2 − 3x + 1) by (x − 4) using the vertical (long-multiplication) method. State the degree of the product and explain how it is related to the degrees of the factors.
questions.answer: Vertical layout — multiply (2x^2 − 3x + 1) by x to get 2x^3 − 3x^2 + x; multiply by −4 to get −8x^2 + 12x − 4; add column by column to get 2x^3 + (−3x^2 − 8x^2) + (x + 12x) + (−4) = 2x^3 − 11x^2 + 13x − 4. Degree of product = 3 = deg(2x^2 − 3x + 1) + deg(x − 4) = 2 + 1.
questions.explanation: Distribute every term of the second factor across every term of the first; combine like terms. The degree-3 product equals the sum of the degrees (2 and 1), which is the multiplication-of-degrees rule.

questions.question: Let p(x) = x^2 − 4x + 4. Compute p(2) and p(3), and decide which (if any) is a zero of p.
questions.explanation: A zero of p(x) is an input that makes the polynomial evaluate to 0. Here only x = 2 satisfies that.
